arabic text: MAI NE KAISAY HUSSAIN KO MAARA
english translation text: Shimr said: do not listen, Mukhtar, to how I killed Hussain.

arabic text:
JAB HUA MAI SAWAAR SEENAY PAR
LAB HILAANAY LAGA TERA MOLA
PYAAS MEI BADDUAAEIN DENAY LAGAY
MUJH KO SHABBIR AISA LAGTA THA
MAI NE HONTO PE KAAN RAKH KE SUNA
WO TO GHAZI KO YAAD KARTA THA
english translation text:
When I mounted your Maula's
chest, his lips began to
move. I thought the thirsty
one was cursing me, so
I placed my ear beside his
lips. He was remembering Ghazi.

arabic text:
KAISI GURBAT THI IBN E ZEHRA PAR
DEKHTI THI SAKINA YE MANZAR
MERE HAATHO MEI SHEH KI DAADHI THI
MAIN RULAATA RAHA USAY HANS KAR
LAASH E ABBAS BHI TADAPNAY LAGI
JAB TAMAANCHA HUSSAIN KO MAARA
english translation text:
What loneliness had descended upon Zahra's son!
Sakina watched that scene.
The King's beard was within my hands,
and I kept making her weep while laughing.
Even Abbas's body began to writhe
when I struck Hussain with a slap.

arabic text:
US KI AANKHO MEIN JAANAY KYA THA AMEER
KOI NAZREI NAHI MILAATA THA
MAI BHI AANKHEI NA US KI DEKH SAKA
IS LIYE CHEHRA US KA PHER DIYA
YE WAJA THI JO PUSHT E GARDAN SE
TERE MOLA KO ZIBHA MAIN NE KIYA
english translation text:
There was something within his eyes, O commander;
no one could meet his gaze.
Even I could not look into his eyes,
so I turned his face away.
That is why I slaughtered your Maula
from the back of his neck.

arabic text:
WO JO IK NEHR HAI WAHAN JAARI
TERA MOLA WAHAN THA ZEEN SE GIRA
UMAR E SAAD NE KAHA MUJH SE
QATL IS KO NASHAIB MEIN KARNA
MAIN YAHAN QATL GAAH TAK MUKHTAR
US KO ZULFO SE KHENCH KAR LAAYA
english translation text:
There is a stream flowing there.
Your Maula fell from the saddle nearby.
Umar ibn Saad told me:
kill him in the low ground.
So, Mukhtar, I dragged him by the hair
to the place of slaughter.

arabic text:
HAAN WO LAMHA AJEEB THA MUKHTAR
MERE HAATHO MEIN TEZ THI TALWAAR
KUND HO JAATA THA MERA KHANJAR
MAI NE YU BHI KIYE THAY TERA WAAR
MUJH SE KAT’TA NA THA GALA US KA
US KI MAA NE THA HAATH RAKHA HUA
english translation text:
Yes, that was a strange moment, Mukhtar.
A sharp sword was in my hand,
yet my dagger kept becoming blunt.
I struck thirteen times,
but could not cut his throat,
for his mother had placed her hand upon it.

arabic text:
AIK TEELA HAI KARBALA MEI JAHAA
RO RAHI THI BEHAN KHADI US KI
MINNATEI KAR RAHI THI HAR IK KI
KEH RAHI THI NAHI CHALAAO CHHURI
US NE SATTAR QADAM SE KAT’TAY HUAY
APNAY BHAI KA KHUD GALA DEKHA
english translation text:
There is a mound in Karbala
where his sister stood weeping.
She pleaded with everyone,
saying: do not move the knife.
From seventy steps away,
she watched her brother's throat being cut.

arabic text:
US NE DEKHA JAB AA GAYI ZAINAB
MUJH SE SHABBIR RO KE KEHNAY LAGA
SHIMR JAANAY DE US KHAIMAY MEI
APNA KHANJAR CHUPA LE US SE ZARA
SHIMR ZAANU HATA LE SEENAY SE
WAASTA HAI TUJHE MUHAMMAD KA
english translation text:
When Zainab approached and he saw her,
Shabbir wept and said to me:
Shimr, let her return to the tent;
hide your dagger from her.
Lift your knee from my chest,
for the sake of Muhammad.

arabic text:
MIR SAJJAD SUN KE US KE SITAM
SAARAY DARBAARI BAYN KARNAY LAGAY
BOLA SHIMR E LAEEN AYE MUKHTAR
KUCH DIKHAAON AGAR IJAAZAT DE
JIS PE KHOO’N THA GHAREEB E ZEHRA KA
US NE KHANJAR WO SAB KO DIKHLAAYA
english translation text:
O Mir Sajjad, hearing of these cruelties,
all those in the court began to lament.
The accursed Shimr said: O Mukhtar,
shall I show you something, if you permit?
Then he displayed the dagger
still stained with the blood of Zahra's lonely son.
